records.name: Memanto Cloud
records.tagline: A companion memory for agents to improve as you work
records.description: A companion memory agent that lets your agents focus and improve while you keep ownership of everything they learn. Now hosted for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 31 more: sign in once, no Docker, no API key.

records.name: greatai Review
records.tagline: Free AI + human code review for open source & nonprofits
records.description: Watch an AI team review your repo, live. Paste a public GitHub repo: quick AI scan in a minute; maintainers then get a full review by an Operum AI agent team on a live board, plus an optional credited human expert. Free for OSS and nonprofits. On Cloud Run.

records.name: Scam Link Check
records.tagline: Paste a suspicious text or link, get a plain-English verdict
records.description: Scam Link Check helps older relatives and anyone who isn't tech-savvy decide if a text or link is safe to tap. Paste a link or the whole message: it finds every web address, checks each with Google Web Risk, follows short links to see where they really go, and flags scam signs like brand look-alike names, brand-new domains, raw IP addresses and missing https. You get Dangerous / Suspicious / No known risk in plain words, plus what to do next. English & Chinese. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

records.name: tripps
records.tagline: Plan a group trip with one link, no account needed
records.description: tripps puts everyone’s flights, trains, stays and plans on one day-by-day itinerary. Send the group one link: friends open it in the browser and edit it, no account or app. Forward a booking email, screenshot or PDF and Smart import adds it on the right day. Nights with nowhere to stay and journeys nobody has booked show on their day. Works offline, and Claude or ChatGPT can plan a tripp for you. Planning is free; tripps Pro adds polls, history and calendars.

records.name: Compass OS
records.tagline: Your career, ready before you need it
records.description: Compass OS is your career's chief of staff, built for senior leaders. It finds Director, VP and Head-of roles across job boards and 90+ hiring systems, scores each against your experience, and tailors your resume with only what's true: every claim is checked against your profile. Compass Apply fills applications in Chrome; you press submit. Between searches it keeps your resume and LinkedIn current and helps you practice interviews. Free plan, no card.

records.name: tensorViz
records.tagline: Let your coding agent see inside your PyTorch model
records.description: Coding agents can read your PyTorch code, but they never see what actually flows through the model. tensorViz runs one real forward pass and turns it into an interactive graph with every module and tensor shape. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search that graph and read the measured shapes, so they fix model code from evidence instead of guesses. Or skip the install: the Model Explorer has graphs of 560+ models from recent papers to browse and discuss. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: aiteam.space
records.tagline: An AI team where every agent has its own computer
records.description: aiteam.space gives each AI teammate, a Son, its own computer. It runs real Claude Code sessions on your own subscription, builds and deploys websites, makes videos, joins your Google Meet calls and handles daily posts. You manage the whole team on a visual org chart, from Claude, ChatGPT, Telegram or Discord. Your first Son is free forever.

records.name: Volcano
records.tagline: The self-healing agent cloud by Kong
records.description: Volcano is one place to build, host and run agents and apps. Deploy from the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi) or the AI Builder. You get year-long durable functions, human-in-the-loop approvals, resumable sandboxes, distributed locks, branchable Postgres, auth, storage, realtime, and backend and Next.js hosting. LavaFlow finds and fixes bugs on its own, so your apps and agents keep getting better over time.

records.name: Fack’d
records.tagline: Fact checks right on YouTube as it plays, with sources
records.description: Open Fack’d beside a YouTube interview or debate to see which claims hold up as you watch. Each check pairs the speaker’s words with a timestamp, a rating, and sources you can read. Watch previously checked videos for free, or sign in for 10 free checks of your own.

records.name: Currents
records.tagline: Currents for Claude & Codex to see all your tests
records.description: Currents records every Playwright test run in CI. Now Claude and Codex can read it. Connect from the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory, sign in, and ask why CI failed. Your agent gets the failure, its history and the trace. Automatically.

records.name: Direct by Instagram
records.tagline: Instagram DMs, without the feed or Instagram account
records.description: Direct is Meta's new standalone messaging app from Instagram. Chat with friends without opening the Instagram feed, Reels, or Stories. Sign in with Instagram to sync your existing conversations, or join using just an email address or phone number. Make chats more personal with drawings, custom stickers, voice effects, Notes, and themes. Currently testing on iOS and Android in Türkiye and Thailand, with additional restrictions for users without Instagram accounts.

records.name: Nova by Vybe
records.tagline: Nova audits your website free, then fixes what it finds
records.description: Vybe's Nova is a free AI agent that audits your website on SEO, speed, conversion, accessibility, and security, then tells you what to fix first. You get a full report in minutes, with before/after mockups and competitor benchmarks. Want the fixes actually done? Nova runs on Vybe, so you can hand her the keys and let her apply the recommendations herself.

records.name: Interview Coach
records.tagline: Practice job interviews out loud
records.description: Practice mock job interviews interactively in a compatible desktop Chrome. Choose a role, provide the job description, and interview style, answer aloud, and get follow-up questions and feedback based on what you said. Practice as often as you like at launch. Speech is processed on your device, and Interview Coach saves no audio or video recordings. Sign in to view and save your coaching report and text transcript.

records.name: Mailpipe
records.tagline: Draft Apple Mail replies with your local AI agent CLI
records.description: Mailpipe drafts Apple Mail replies using your existing AI agent CLI, including Codex and Claude Code. Open the Mailpipe panel from Mail’s reply or forward toolbar to review, generate, or regenerate a draft, then copy and paste it into Mail to send. Menu-bar review is also available. Attachments aren’t passed to the agent; drafts stay on your Mac. Model processing and costs depend on your agent’s configuration.

records.name: Rox
records.tagline: Your AI companion for living with chronic illness
records.description: Rox is an AI health companion for people living with chronic illness, including POTS, fibromyalgia, ME/CFS, MS, and long COVID. Track symptoms and medications, connect wearable health data, spot patterns, and prepare for doctor appointments in one place. Rox remembers your health context over time, so you can spend less energy explaining your story and more time managing everyday life.

records.name: Samiksa
records.tagline: Understand research, test it yourself, publish your own
records.description: Samiksa is an AI co-researcher. Give it a paper, blog post or any document, and it turns it into an interactive document shaped by your questions, not by how it was written. Ask what you want to know and the page reshapes around the answer, each claim traced to its source. Then launch a sandbox experiment: rerun what the research shared, or test your own hypothesis as your co-researcher helps with code and data. Your own work goes from rough idea to research you can publish. Join the waitlist.

records.name: Storiara
records.tagline: AI producers that find real savings in your film budget
records.description: Upload a script and Storiara builds the breakdown, stripboard, budget and call sheets. New: the Producer Room. An AI 1st AD, line producer, locations manager and casting lead read your schedule and budget and look for savings. Each idea is priced with your own rates before you see it, and only the ones that hold up reach you. Also new: sides go out with the call sheet, and each actor gets only their scenes.

records.name: Andromon
records.tagline: Your Android phone, on your computer. Free.
records.description: Andromon is a free desktop app for managing your Android phone from Windows, macOS or Linux, over USB or Wi-Fi. Mirror and control the screen, text from your keyboard, see calls and notifications, move photos, files and music, back up everything in one click, and remove bloatware safely. Developer tools too: shell, logcat, test automation and an API inspector. Plus a phone companion app and a web version. No root, no account, no cloud, no ads.

records.name: UndoGuard
records.tagline: The Ctrl+Z button for autonomous AI agents
records.description: Giving AI agents write access to production is risky—one bad DELETE or PUT can wipe customer data. UndoGuard is a "Ctrl+Z" rollback proxy & MCP server that sits between your agents and APIs. It automatically snapshots and AES-256 encrypts state before every mutating call, letting you revert single mistakes or entire agent sessions in 1 click. Works with Claude, Cursor, LangChain, n8n, or any REST API. Try the live sandbox free (1,000 actions/mo).

records.name: Saparo
records.tagline: Muse for shopping with deals stacks
records.description: Saparo is a personal shopping agent that stacks every deal. Tell it what you want, and it searches U.S. stores for the same item in your size, combining promo codes, cash back, and eligible card offers that work together. It ranks options by estimated total cost, including shipping and tax, so you skip the legwork. With your approval, Saparo applies selected offers and gets checkout ready. You review the order and make the final payment yourself.

records.name: NetSieve
records.tagline: Block ads, trackers and scam sites in every app on your Mac
records.description: NetSieve blocks ads, trackers and known scam sites for every app on your Mac, not just your browser. See which apps go online, which companies they reach and which countries your data ends up in. Your history stays on your Mac. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: ThreadLore
records.tagline: Turn fabric photos into editable loom drafts
records.description: When a textile’s weaving instructions are lost, a photograph still holds clues. ThreadLore helps handweavers inspect a fabric photo, check a suggested weave against the yarn crossings, and turn the pattern they approve into a printable loom card or WIF file.

records.name: Same Moon
records.tagline: Free bedtime stories for children who had to leave home
records.description: Gentle bedtime stories in English, Arabic and Spanish for refugee and displaced children, read aloud and built for cheap phones: tiny first load, works offline, no sign-up, no tracking. A person approves every story and every voice before a child hears it.

records.name: Baby's Day In
records.tagline: Turn two phones into a baby monitor
records.description: Not another baby cam. An AI baby monitor that works on any spare phone: it hears the cry, tells you, and starts the lullaby itself. No hardware to buy. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Zethos
records.tagline: The ledger you and your AI work from
records.description: Zethos reads your email, Slack, calendar, meetings and more to track what you've promised others and what they've promised you, then closes each one automatically when it's done. Read-only on your accounts. Available on Mac and iOS, and readable and editable by any MCP-connected AI.

records.name: Kuc-kuc
records.tagline: A knock on the door when dangerous weather comes
records.description: When dangerous weather is forecast, Kuc-kuc phones an older person who lives alone and asks if they are okay. No answer, or “I’m not well”? It phones a neighbour to go and knock. The family sees every step. Works on a landline. Runs on Cloud Run.

records.name: Inkrail
records.tagline: A cozy, nostalgic typewriter experience built for deep work.
records.description: Inkrail brings the charm of a vintage typewriter to your Mac and Windows systems. Enjoy textured paper, warm desk lamps, customizable aesthetics, and satisfying typing sounds. Switch to Focus Mode for distraction-free writing. Native, free, open-source, and local-first.

records.name: Stormi
records.tagline: An AI team on your iPhone that does real work
records.description: Stormi gives you a team of AI agents on your iPhone. Each bot has a name, one job, and its own model. They keep working on our server when your phone is off, and stop to ask before they send, pay, or delete anything. 89 plugins, hundreds of models.

records.name: InteraOne
records.tagline: Open-source Intercom & Zendesk alternative with AI agents
records.description: InteraOne is the open-source, agentic alternative to Intercom & Zendesk. AI and human agents in one inbox, with one-click setup and deployment, self-hosted or cloud.

records.name: Lumyna Community Challenge
records.tagline: A million virtual meters. A small pledge against hunger.
records.description: Roll, dodge meteors and collect light in a 2.5D browser game. Together, we're aiming for 1,000,000 virtual meters. I pledge CA$1 per completed 10,000 accepted meters to the World Food Programme, with a CA$1 minimum and CA$100 cap. Players don't pay. Shared rankings and separate community stats track our progress. Independent maker initiative; no WFP affiliation or endorsement. Donation pending.

records.name: Cup of Sugar
records.tagline: Share a dream, let Cubby break it into small steps.
records.description: Post a dream, break it into small steps, and let your neighbors chip in with good deeds.

records.name: pickfit
records.tagline: Every tool tested in a sandbox before it's recommended
records.description: pickfit is a free software advisor for people and their AI agents. Before it recommends a tool, it installs it in a fresh sandbox, checks the features work and replays the steps offline. Then you get the steps that actually worked. No ads, no referral links.

records.name: tinytldr
records.tagline: Templates for your agents
records.description: Design a template once in your browser. Claude or ChatGPT then fills it over MCP from any source (dashboards, articles, release notes) and exports a polished image, carousel or video. Pair it with Slack for a review flow. Open source, MIT.

records.name: Dozy
records.tagline: Turns your sleep data into one thing to do today
records.description: Tired and not sure what to do about it? Dozy reads your sleep from Apple Health, works out how much you need and what you owe, and gives you one action a day: a short nap or the right bedtime. On iPhone and Apple Watch, with Oura and Garmin. Free.

records.name: Salus
records.tagline: Discover benefits and public support in the Czech Republic
records.description: Find Czech benefits, allowances and public support in four languages. Explore programs, answer optional questions and follow official application links. Free to use, with no account needed. Informational guidance, not a legal eligibility decision.

records.name: Veryfi Thinking Mode
records.tagline: AI agents review and correct receipt and invoice data.
records.description: Thinking Mode is Veryfi's agentic data extraction. Add the thinking parameter to a document request, and AI agents review the extraction, catch mistakes and correct them before the results come back. It currently works with receipts and invoices.

records.name: DWaste
records.tagline: Eliminate recycling contamination with low-power Edge AI
records.description: DWaste is an AI-powered app that helps users sort waste correctly and earn rewards for proper recycling.

records.name: FFMPA Kids News
records.tagline: Calm, fact-checked news for kids 5 to 15
records.description: A calm morning and evening news edition for kids 5 to 15, at three reading levels and fact checked before it goes out. Tap words to learn them, follow one Big Story all week, then the edition ends. No ads, no links out, no chat. Free for families and schools.

records.name: HelpCard
records.tagline: a free emergency QR card
records.description: Make a free emergency card with a QR code: blood group, allergies, medicines and who to call. Nothing is stored. Fun themes for kids.

records.name: Badya
records.tagline: Learn languages from real content with an agentic AI tutor
records.description: Stop tapping matching cards. Start speaking. Badya turns any YouTube video or article into a lesson, then has you practice with an AI tutor: voice conversations, real-life role-plays, and spaced-repetition flashcards that quiz you out loud. Now on Android.

records.name: Groundwork
records.tagline: Claude Code plans that re-runs never overwrite
records.description: A Claude Code skill that scaffolds a plan folder: research, design, plan, tracking, and an HTML board. Re-runs only rewrite the blocks it generated, checked by a hash. Your own text stays as you wrote it. Free, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Tamekoshi
records.tagline: A Tamagotchi-style AI companion that does real work
records.description: Tame is an AI companion that does real work from the top of your screen: one message with three asks becomes three subagents in parallel, it runs tasks on its own computer, answers clients on WhatsApp and Telegram and writes meeting notes speaker by speaker. Nothing acts without your OK. Think Tamagotchi, all grown up. Free beta; a mobile app, multiplayer and open source are on the roadmap.

records.name: Docker
records.tagline: Built to run on trust, for the agentic era
records.description: Docker is evolving for the agentic era. Containers isolate workloads, but agents aren't workloads: they're actors that need isolation, security and governance. The new Docker brings a trusted supply chain for agents to build from, a trusted runtime to isolate them (Docker Sandboxes), and governance for agents across every team (Docker AI Governance), alongside a redesigned brand and Moby whale.

records.name: Telo
records.tagline: Apple Health in ChatGPT and Claude, in any country
records.description: Telo is an iPhone app that sends your Apple Health history to the AI you already use. Connect once, then ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or Cursor about your sleep, training and recovery. Every answer shows the records it read. The Apple Health connections built into ChatGPT and Claude are US-only, and Claude's needs a paid plan. Telo works in any country and on Claude's free plan. Your last 7 days are free. Pro is $49 a year for your full history.

records.name: DMARC Pulse
records.tagline: Find out who's sending email as your domain
records.description: Gmail and Yahoo now push email that fails SPF, DKIM or DMARC to spam, or reject it. Your DMARC reports show exactly who sends as your domain, but they arrive as daily XML nobody reads. DMARC Pulse reads them for you: every sender matched by name, spoofers flagged, plain-language fixes, email alerts when something breaks, and a guided path from p=none to quarantine. Free for 1 domain, plus 16 free checkers with no signup.

records.name: Megumi Planner
records.tagline: Grow a garden together, and a community grows with it
records.description: Some of the best moments in a neighborhood happen in a garden: kids picking their first fig, neighbors swapping seedlings, strangers becoming friends over a shared harvest. Megumi Planner helps people dream up that place together. Draw your garden or food forest on a photo of your land, watch it grow over the years, and share it with a link so everyone can see the dream and join in. Because a garden planned together becomes a place where everyone belongs. Free in beta. 🌱

records.name: Tripmojo
records.tagline: Agentic travel app that helps plan, book and run your trip
records.description: Tripmojo syncs your booking emails into one shared trip, then Mojo, your AI travel agent, helps run it. Plan in a group chat where Mojo answers, runs polls and finds places. On travel day Mojo tries to check you in, saves your boarding pass, flags delays and gate changes, and tells you when to leave. On the trip it keeps today's plan current and splits expenses. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Bookella
records.tagline: A reading tracker that helps you read more
records.description: Bookella is a reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android. Add books in seconds: search 122 million titles in 28 languages, pick from reading lists, scan a whole shelf of barcodes at once, or let AI pick your next book. Set yearly and daily reading goals, time your sessions, and track your reading pace. Keep notes and quotes, and see when and how much you read. You can also import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV. No ads.

records.name: Conversaflex
records.tagline: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams
records.description: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams in French, English and Spanish. Employees practise real work situations (client calls, meetings, safety briefings) with Madame AI and get feedback on every sound they say. HR gets CEFR placement from A1 to C2, a progress dashboard, and participation records for reporting, including Quebec's Bill 96. Used by teams at GSK and Canam. Hosted in Canada, with pronunciation scoring on Google Cloud Run.

records.name: EarthSort
records.tagline: Ask how to recycle anything and get your city's answer
records.description: Recycling rules change at every city line, so the same cup is recycling at home and trash at work. Most sites only give generic guidance that's often wrong for your city. Ask EarthSort gives you your city's answer: type any item or upload a photo at earthsort.com/ask. No app needed. Local rules for 750+ US cities, with more added every day. Want it on the go? The free EarthSort app does the same with your camera.

records.name: AI Call
records.tagline: An AI that answers and makes your business calls
records.description: AI Call answers your business line and makes outbound calls for you. The AI talks with callers, takes down what they need, records it and puts them through to your staff when needed. No base fee: $5/month per number, $0.30 per connected minute.

records.name: AI Gateway
records.tagline: Manage your company's AI from one place
records.description: AI Gateway puts your self-hosted models and providers like OpenAI, Groq and Together behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It runs on your own servers. Your GPUs take the traffic first, vendors step in when needed, and you decide who uses what.

records.name: Thruddle
records.tagline: Discover events in UK pubs: live music, quizzes and more
records.description: Thruddle is the easiest way to discover great pubs near you across the UK. See live music, quiz nights, and pub events near you in a single tap. Recurring events are tagged "Weekly" or "Monthly" so you know what's a one-off and what's a regular. Filter by what you actually care about: real ale, beer gardens, dog-friendly, pool tables, live sports, family-friendly, WiFi and more. Browse pubs near you on a map or as a list, with photos and accessibility info. Opening hours, a clear "Open now"...

records.name: Bimdrop
records.tagline: BIM file sharing. Simple and fast
records.description: Open and share BIM and CAD files in the browser: Revit (RVT), IFC, STEP, IGES, Rhino (3DM), Tekla (DB1, DSTV NC1), DXF, BTLX, glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, 3MF, USDZ and 70 file types in total. Share via link or embed an interactive 3D viewer. No sign-up needed to try it. Free — 10 files per month.

records.name: MakePixel
records.tagline: Pixel art editor for game sprites, tilesets and maps
records.description: MakePixel is a pixel art editor for game assets that runs in your browser, iPad included. Animate sprites with the keys you know from Aseprite, draw a few tiles to get a full autotile set, paint levels, and export to Godot, Unity or Tiled. Free to start.

records.name: Vatsalya Circle
records.tagline: Family elder care: check-ins, missed alerts, SOS, scam help
records.description: A free app for families looking after ageing parents. Medicine and daily check-ins ring like an alarm, the family hears only when one is missed, siblings take turns, SOS alerts everyone, and Safety Check helps elders with scam calls. English, Hindi, Bengali, Kannada.

records.name: Shozito
records.tagline: Showcase your Products, Projects & Work. Grow Business.
records.description: Shozito is the business presentation & sales app for builders, architects, interior designers, manufacturers, dealers, photographers, makeup artists and creative professionals. Showcase your work, scan business cards & QR codes into leads, send quotations & invoices and close more deals - from one app.

records.name: Scam Link Check
records.tagline: Paste a suspicious text or link, get a plain-English verdict
records.description: Scam Link Check helps older relatives and anyone who isn't tech-savvy decide if a text or link is safe to tap. records.name: Laps
records.tagline: Daily pages for your exam books, rebalanced as you go
records.description: Enter a book's pages, a finish date and how many times to read it. Laps tells you today's pages, and when you fall behind or get ahead it spreads what's left evenly until your finish date. 1 book free, one payment for more. No subscription.

records.name: Pathway: Habit Tracker & Goals
records.tagline: Routine Planner & Daily Streak
records.description: Make room for small habits - and a city of your own. Pathway turns reading, movement, study and other everyday actions into growing neighborhoods. NEW IN 1.2 • New design: the app is cleaner and easier to use. • Goals from day one: as you pick habits, set the days and a goal for each one right away. • Friends: invite friends with a link and see their cities and latest activity. • Together: build as a team, and every completed task adds a brick to a shared construction.

records.name: Nexuro AI
records.tagline: Build AI chatbots from your own content in minutes
records.description: Nexuro AI helps you turn your PDFs, documents, and website content into intelligent AI chatbots in minutes. Train personalized AI assistants on your own data, embed them on any website, and let them answer customer questions 24/7. No complex setup, no AI development expertise required — just your data, your AI.

records.name: Mailpipe
