records.name: Rabotka Business
records.tagline: Complete recruitment software
records.description: Recruitment software (ATS) for companies and organisations in Africa: job posting, CV analysis, applicant tracking, interviews and team hiring.

records.name: DMARC Pulse
records.tagline: Find out who's sending email as your domain
records.description: Gmail and Yahoo now push email that fails SPF, DKIM or DMARC to spam, or reject it. Your DMARC reports show exactly who sends as your domain, but they arrive as daily XML nobody reads. DMARC Pulse reads them for you: every sender matched by name, spoofers flagged, plain-language fixes, email alerts when something breaks, and a guided path from p=none to quarantine. Free for 1 domain, plus 16 free checkers with no signup.

records.name: Megumi Planner
records.tagline: Grow a garden together, and a community grows with it
records.description: Some of the best moments in a neighborhood happen in a garden: kids picking their first fig, neighbors swapping seedlings, strangers becoming friends over a shared harvest. Megumi Planner helps people dream up that place together. Draw your garden or food forest on a photo of your land, watch it grow over the years, and share it with a link so everyone can see the dream and join in. Because a garden planned together becomes a place where everyone belongs. Free in beta. 🌱

records.name: Tripmojo
records.tagline: Agentic travel app that helps plan, book and run your trip
records.description: Tripmojo syncs your booking emails into one shared trip, then Mojo, your AI travel agent, helps run it. Plan in a group chat where Mojo answers, runs polls and finds places. On travel day Mojo tries to check you in, saves your boarding pass, flags delays and gate changes, and tells you when to leave. On the trip it keeps today's plan current and splits expenses. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Bookella
records.tagline: A reading tracker that helps you read more
records.description: Bookella is a reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android. Add books in seconds: search 122 million titles in 28 languages, pick from reading lists, scan a whole shelf of barcodes at once, or let AI pick your next book. Set yearly and daily reading goals, time your sessions, and track your reading pace. Keep notes and quotes, and see when and how much you read. You can also import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV. No ads.

records.name: Conversaflex
records.tagline: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams
records.description: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams in French, English and Spanish. Employees practise real work situations (client calls, meetings, safety briefings) with Madame AI and get feedback on every sound they say. HR gets CEFR placement from A1 to C2, a progress dashboard, and participation records for reporting, including Quebec's Bill 96. Used by teams at GSK and Canam. Hosted in Canada, with pronunciation scoring on Google Cloud Run.

records.name: EarthSort
records.tagline: Ask how to recycle anything and get your city's answer
records.description: Recycling rules change at every city line, so the same cup is recycling at home and trash at work. Most sites only give generic guidance that's often wrong for your city. Ask EarthSort gives you your city's answer: type any item or upload a photo at earthsort.com/ask. No app needed. Local rules for 750+ US cities, with more added every day. Want it on the go? The free EarthSort app does the same with your camera.

records.name: The Idea Machine
records.tagline: Random Idea Generator for projects, apps and hackathons
records.description: The Idea Machine is a free random idea generator for side projects, apps and hackathons. Each roll combines three reels into one idea. Product mode: a space in human life (like sleep or saving money), a product form (like a browser extension or a newsletter) and an unexpected twist. Hackathon mode: a topic, a tech and a twist, sized for a weekend. Lock any reel you like and roll the rest. Over 1,000,000 combinations per mode.

records.name: PostHog MCP Analytics
records.tagline: See how AI agents actually use your MCP server
records.description: MCP Analytics shows how AI agents use your MCP server. Every tool call is logged with inputs, responses, duration and errors, plus error rate and p95 latency per tool. It also captures agent intent, the models agents report, and requests for tools you don't have yet. Failed calls land in Error Tracking, and every event works in PostHog dashboards, alerts and SQL. Open beta, free to start, no card needed.

records.name: CosmeScan
records.tagline: Decode 2,375+ cosmetic batch codes & spot Vinted fakes
records.description: CosmeScan is a free web app and Chrome extension that decodes cosmetic and perfume batch codes across 2,375+ brands. Instantly check manufacturing dates, shelf life, EU Safety Gate recalls, and banned-ingredient cutoffs like Lilial. Built for secondhand shoppers on Vinted and eBay, its AI Vision scanner reads engraved codes directly from listing photos, flags known cloned counterfeit serials, and generates shareable verification certificates.

records.name: IXXO Cart
records.tagline: Online store for €1 a month, 0% of your sales
records.description: A hosted online store for €1 a month, not a trial. Early-bird price: join now and keep €1 while you stay subscribed. 0% fee on sales, payments go straight to your own Stripe or PayPal. Reviews, wishlists, EU VAT, invoices and seven templates included. Connect ChatGPT or Claude through MCP. Free move from Shopify.

records.name: Luxiva AI
records.tagline: From a business review to knowledge you can reuse
records.description: Luxiva helps founders and builders turn connected data into a business review they can check, share, and reuse. In a monthly performance review, you connect customer and order data to see whether growth is producing more repeat business. Luxiva Copilot helps set metrics, flags missing evidence, and you can share the analysis so others can inspect it and ask questions. Confirmed definitions, rules, and methods are kept as knowledge assets, so the next review starts from what you already agreed.

records.name: Almanac
records.tagline: Keep the analytics history your vendors throw away
records.description: Cloudflare deletes unsampled web analytics after 7 days, App Store Connect reaches back about 120 days, and Stripe never adds up a day. Almanac writes down your Cloudflare Web Analytics, App Store Connect and Stripe numbers every day and keeps them in your private iCloud: Core Web Vitals, human vs automated page loads, downloads, proceeds, refunds. No backend, no account. Free to start, Pro is $5.99 once. On Mac, iPhone and iPad.

records.name: AI Call
records.tagline: An AI that answers and makes your business calls
records.description: AI Call answers your business line and makes outbound calls for you. The AI talks with callers, takes down what they need, records it and puts them through to your staff when needed. No base fee: $5/month per number, $0.30 per connected minute.

records.name: AI Gateway
records.tagline: Manage your company's AI from one place
records.description: AI Gateway puts your self-hosted models and providers like OpenAI, Groq and Together behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It runs on your own servers. Your GPUs take the traffic first, vendors step in when needed, and you decide who uses what.

records.name: Thruddle
records.tagline: Discover events in UK pubs: live music, quizzes and more
records.description: Thruddle is the easiest way to discover great pubs near you across the UK. See live music, quiz nights, and pub events near you in a single tap. Recurring events are tagged "Weekly" or "Monthly" so you know what's a one-off and what's a regular. Filter by what you actually care about: real ale, beer gardens, dog-friendly, pool tables, live sports, family-friendly, WiFi and more. Browse pubs near you on a map or as a list, with photos and accessibility info. Opening hours, a clear "Open now"...

records.name: WordConverter.app
records.tagline: Free PDF to Word converter, no account needed
records.description: Convert PDFs to Word documents with no account required. Preview pages, choose an editable-text or image-based layout, and process up to 25 files per batch. Files are sent to a conversion service; size and page limits apply.

records.name: Bitefolio
records.tagline: Turn any recipe photo into a hands-free cooking session
records.description: Bitefolio is where your recipes live and where you cook them. Snap a cookbook page or a handwritten card and it becomes ingredients and steps. Cook step by step with timers, or hands-free: say "next" and ask the AI sous-chef mid-recipe. Plan the week, get a grocery list from what you planned, and share dishes with home cooks and chefs in six languages. Free on iOS and Android with no ads; Pro adds voice cooking and the AI tools.

records.name: Anya
records.tagline: A personal AI agent. Send a message, get finished work back.
records.description: Anya is a personal AI agent on WhatsApp and iMessage, made by IMAI. Send a message, get finished work back. Research a person or company before a meeting, find potential buyers, or work through a complex forecast. For fast, affordable answers, there's Instinct. For complex work, there's Anya: deeper thinking, less rework. The first 500 new Product Hunt users get $50 in free credits when they sign up through imai.studio/anya.

records.name: Extreme Demon Gacha
records.tagline: Open packs to collect Geometry Dash Extreme Demon cards.
records.description: Play Extreme Demon Gacha for free in your browser and collect cards based on Geometry Dash’s Extreme Demon levels. Try three five-card packs without signing in, discover rare cards and holo variants, and track what you’ve collected and what’s still missing. Search the card catalog by level name or Geometry Dash ID, filter by rarity, and view each card’s drop rate alongside the level’s publisher, difficulty ranking, and verification video.

records.name: Remindance
records.tagline: Keep track of every “I’ll get back to you.”
records.description: Paste or forward a message: Remindance writes down who promised what and by when, counts the days, and emails you when someone goes quiet. Everything lands in two tidy lists, They owe me and I owe, sorted by how long each has waited, so you see at a glance what needs a nudge.

records.name: Retivo
records.tagline: See how much your Stripe subscriptions leak, in dollars
records.description: Retivo is a Revenue Leak Report for Stripe subscription businesses. You share a restricted, read-only Stripe key, and within 48 hours you get four leaks measured in dollars per month (failed payments, cancellations, unconverted trials and more) plus the top three fixes. The report is a one-time $490. If you want the fixes done, an optional 90-day pilot is paid on measured uplift against a holdout group. Retivo never changes anything in your Stripe account.

records.name: Bokvo
records.tagline: Boat Charter Management Software
records.description: Bokvo is boat charter management software for private charters and shared trips. Take orders in seconds, keep every boat and captain on one schedule, chat with crew inside the trip, and track payments and revenue — so a charter business stops running on Excel, WhatsApp and paper. Works for fishing charters, yacht charters and boat tours.

records.name: jdelete
records.tagline: Data broker removal you run once. No subscription.
records.description: jdelete sends removal and stop-sale requests to 900+ US data brokers as your authorized agent, then tracks every reply. $9.99 per scan, no subscription. Run it again whenever you want. There is also a free do-it-yourself tool. US only for now.

records.name: BizzRadar
records.tagline: AI knows who it recommends instead of you. Now you can too.
records.description: Type your business name and ZIP. In about a minute, free: a score out of 100, the #1 thing holding you back, one fix for today with a draft, your closest rival, and which businesses AI assistants recommend instead of you. Full Report $30 once.

records.name: Okrly
records.tagline: Personal OKRs for solopreneurs, on your Mac and iPhone
records.description: Okrly is an app for one person who wants goals they can measure, on Mac and iPhone. Pick a few objectives, give each key results (number, percentage or milestone) and update them weekly. okrly weighs your progress against time elapsed: On track, Slightly behind or Behind. Your cycle is one drawing; finished cycles grow into a tree. No account, no subscription. Mac: $8.99 launch price until Nov 30. iPhone: $3.99. One-time purchase. iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac. macOS 14+, iOS 18+.

records.name: ZaBox
records.tagline: Organize your bookmarks, plans and files in one place.
records.description: ZaBox is your personal start page for the whole web: bookmarks, plans, todos and files in one calm grid. It ships with 137 curated sites in 15 categories, one-click presets for designers, developers and entertainment, and syncs across phone, computer and tablet through your own GitHub or Gitee repo. Your data stays in your browser by default. Free, open source (MIT), with an Edge extension and a desktop app.

records.name: Always Weather
records.tagline: Calm weather app that shows exactly when rain stops
records.description: A calm weather app for iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, Android, Pixel Watch, Windows and Linux. Drag one thumb through the hours: the whole screen turns into that hour, and one plain sentence sums up the day ("Rain from 13:00, clearing by 16:00."). Rain map for Europe and North America, official warnings, widgets and a watch face. Forecasts from national weather services. Paid once, free on Linux. No subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Astronaad
records.tagline: AI + human astrologers for Vedic, Western & Chinese
records.description: Astronaad is an all-in-one astrology platform: AI guidance plus verified human astrologers. Ask Nakshatra, our AI astrologer, anything in 24 languages — answers built on your actual birth chart, not generic scripts. Start free with no sign-up using 14+ tools (Free Kundli, Kundli Matching, daily horoscope, Panchang, Rahu Kaal), or go deeper with detailed Kundli, matchmaking, yearly forecast and BaZi reports. Book a live astrologer by chat or call. One wallet, local currency.

records.name: Calynta
records.tagline: Video call an AI that remembers you
records.description: Calynta is a personal AI you can message or video call. Talk face to face and it talks back like a person, remembers what you said last week, sees what you hold up and checks the web live, mid-call. Sketch problems together on a shared board, bring three assistants into a Council Call for big decisions, and leave every call with an Outcome Receipt. It never sends, posts or spends without your yes. On iOS, Android, Galaxy Store and the web.

records.name: Forge
records.tagline: Context-Driven Agentic Workspace
records.description: Forge is a context-driven agentic workspace for engineers where AI agents create and manage context in your sessions so you can focus on problem solving and building your product.

records.name: Netfox
records.tagline: Your network in plain English: every device and open port
records.description: Your network in plain English, native on your Mac: every device named and explained, with its ports and history. New since launch, in 70 releases: • An Overview that opens on what needs attention • Names and models from the devices themselves • A sweep that finds silent devices • Look inside any open port • Every port your own Mac is listening on • Wi-Fi and link diagnostics in plain English • Keeps watching from the menu bar. No cloud, no account, no telemetry. Free. macOS 15.6+.

records.name: Taal
records.tagline: Music your child makes, not just watches
records.description: Taal turns your family's favourite music into brand-new songs a four-year-old can play, on the instrument you already have: piano, xylophone, ukulele, lyre, or big on-screen keys. Paste a few YouTube songs your family loves and Taal writes songs at your child's level. Each song plays first, then hands your child the turn. 9 albums, 81 songs, including festival and Hindi songs, a part for a grown-up, and make-it-up songs. No ads.

records.name: Lucerna
records.tagline: Fast, minimal Rust code editor for reviewing agent code
records.description: Lucerna is a fast, minimal code editor written in Rust, with no AI inside. Your agent writes the code in Claude Code, Codex or a desktop app; Lucerna is where you read it: browse the project, see what the agent just changed, and fix the rest yourself. Native GPU-drawn UI, 169 MB idle memory (VS Code: 879 MB), 50 MB app. VS Code keys, settings.json and keybindings.json just work. No telemetry, no account. Free and open source; macOS today, Linux and Windows planned.

records.name: Replay: Race Your Own Road
records.tagline: Record any street. Race it.
records.description: Record any street and race it. Mount your phone, film a drive, and seconds later that road is a 3D race track: its bends, its hills, its light, the traffic light where you stopped. Race a ghost of your real drive, or host up to 10 friends on the same Wi-Fi with no accounts. Or race solo on 30 built-in roads. You drive: gas, brake, turbo, tilt to steer. One hover a lap, two red lights a race, police if you run them. Free on iPhone and iPad. Your footage never leaves the phone.

records.name: Viralcut
records.tagline: Turn your photos into a trend-ready vertical video
records.description: Viralcut turns your photos and clips into a vertical video cut to a format that's trending right now: a hook, beat-synced cuts, captions and an original beat you can post anywhere. Your photos never leave your phone: the video is made right on your device. Type what it's about and it writes the hook and captions. Free, no account, no ads. Made by Dominares.

records.name: Living Gallery
records.tagline: Walk around inside famous paintings on iPhone and iPad
records.description: 11 small worlds you can walk around in, each drawn live in the brushwork of one painting: The Starry Night, Grande Jatte, a Song-dynasty ink landscape and more. No goals, no ads, no accounts. 3 worlds are free; one purchase opens the other 8.

records.name: Cironix
records.tagline: Cironix es un asistente de IA gratuito
records.description: Cironix es un asistente de IA gratuito. Entrás con Google o con tu correo, sin tarjeta.

records.name: Unfolded
records.tagline: Every unfold of your iPhone Duo, counted
records.description: Unfolded counts every time you open your iPhone Duo and puts it on your Home Screen: the last seven days, today hour by hour, and a level that climbs every 500 unfolds. A shortcut it hands you does the counting, even with the app closed. Your log stays on your phone with a copy in your own iCloud. No account, no servers, no analytics. Free.

records.name: TakeHome Sheet
records.tagline: See what you really keep from freelance invoices
records.description: An Excel workbook for cross-border freelancers to track invoice fees and real take-home income. Log up to 200 invoices, configure payment-route fees and exchange rates, estimate tax reserves, and work backwards from a take-home goal to the amount you should quote. Includes a monthly dashboard and example data. $19 one-time download; Microsoft Excel required. Fee defaults are examples, not tax or accounting advice.

records.name: Bimdrop
records.tagline: BIM file sharing. Simple and fast
records.description: Open and share BIM and CAD files in the browser: Revit (RVT), IFC, STEP, IGES, Rhino (3DM), Tekla (DB1, DSTV NC1), DXF, BTLX, glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, 3MF, USDZ and 70 file types in total. Share via link or embed an interactive 3D viewer. No sign-up needed to try it. Free — 10 files per month.

records.name: MakePixel
records.tagline: Pixel art editor for game sprites, tilesets and maps
records.description: MakePixel is a pixel art editor for game assets that runs in your browser, iPad included. Animate sprites with the keys you know from Aseprite, draw a few tiles to get a full autotile set, paint levels, and export to Godot, Unity or Tiled. Free to start.

records.name: JunctionBox AI
records.tagline: Your AI coding agents and your TV, in one local app
records.description: A local control plane for AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Ollama together, in teams, on schedules, sandboxed or not. It also turns Roku, Google TV and Fire TV into your home screen. 25 plugins. Free for two agents, no account.

records.name: WorkApp
records.tagline: Field team reports, timesheets & job profit in one app
records.description: WorkApp — digital timesheets and mobile-team management built for service companies (electrical, security, HVAC, construction, IT). Forget lost paper timesheets and clunky Excel sheets — jobs, hours, materials and invoices flow through one mobile app. Live cost per job and profit per client. 14-day free trial, no card.

records.name: Adhara
records.tagline: The operating system for online business
records.description: Adhara replaces the pile of apps behind your online business — website, commerce, CRM, email, scheduling and content — with one engineered system built to work with you and your AI tools.

records.name: QR Wild
records.tagline: One QR code for reviews, bookings, menus, and more
records.description: Give customers an easy next step from your counter, table, or business card. QR Wild uses AI to help local businesses build a mobile page with links to Google reviews, booking, menus, and social profiles. Print a branded QR code, update the page while the code stays active, and see daily visits through your QR link. Build and preview free without an account. Ongoing hosting is paid.

records.name: Awesome Homebrew Games
records.tagline: Curated homebrew games for your old hardware
records.description: Finding games for old hardware means digging through forums and wikis. Awesome Homebrew Games puts the useful places in one reviewed directory. Browse 70 places across 21 platforms, filter by machine, and use llms.txt with AI assistants.

records.name: embedio
records.tagline: Get an HTML form endpoint without a backend
records.description: Add forms, live chat and booking pages to static sites with one lightweight embed. Get an HTML form endpoint without a backend. Start building free.

records.name: .Socia
records.tagline: Connect. Create. Grow Your Brand for Free.
records.description: .socia makes social discovery, community building and brand promotion accessible without paid advertising. Creators, businesses and everyday users often struggle to gain visibility, reach audiences and build engagement without costly ads. With global social media ad spending projected to approach $395 billion in 2026,socia offers a free alternative: 15+ minutes of daily Spotlight promotion, human-AI communities, trending content discovery and standard social tools.

records.name: Draftland
records.tagline: Five people, five opinions. Keep the best of each.
records.description: For founders, makers, freelancers, copywriters, micro-agencies, and anyone who wants to turn feedback into the best final version. Send one link: each person's notes become their own version beside your original, and you pick what goes into the final one.

records.name: PocketEar
records.tagline: Remembers what was said, decided and promised
records.description: Hit record, or import a voice note from WhatsApp or Voice Memos. PocketEar transcribes it in 16 languages, summarizes what matters, pulls out action items with due dates, and lets you ask your recordings anything later. Organize by person, folder or category, and see what's on your plate this week.

records.name: HelplineCheck
records.tagline: Test your helpline bot before someone in need does
records.description: HelplineCheck is an open-source safety audit for helpline chatbots. It turns public harm cases into 12 repeatable checks, runs them against your own bot in parallel, and hands your team a shareable report quoting the bot. Flawed bot: 3/12. Fixed: 12/12. Opt-in only for your own bots.

records.name: Foldinto
records.tagline: A desk where saved things don't gather dust
records.description: A desk where saved things don't gather dust: clip what you want to read, write one line of your own, and fold it into that day's calendar.

records.name: Burn It
records.tagline: Burn ancestor money and personal letters on your iPhone
records.description: A small digital ritual for remembering someone or letting go. Burn ancestor money, or write a personal letter and watch it fill the screen as it turns to ash. Free to start, with an optional one-time unlock.

records.name: Editvu
records.tagline: Cut your retakes and add captions to talking-head videos
records.description: Upload your raw talking-head recording. Editvu keeps your best take of every line, cuts the retakes, stumbles and silences, and adds word-by-word captions in 30 languages. Want a change? Type it in the chat. Runs in your browser; your first video is free.

records.name: CIO Helm
records.tagline: Free AI readiness and digital maturity tools for CIOs
records.description: CIO Helm gives CIOs and IT leaders the working files behind the job. Start free, no account: a Digital Maturity Assessment and an AI Readiness Check with instant scores, a roadmap and a PowerPoint deck, the IT Roles and Skills Cards, a GCC Cost Model, Excel templates and 18 guides. When you need more: 29 toolkits of Excel workbooks and board decks, each with a worked example, at one fixed price per kit. No subscription.

records.name: ExpenseFlow
records.tagline: Automatic Mileage Tracker & Receipt Scanner
records.description: Free to start. ExpenseFlow auto-tracks every mile by GPS and scans every receipt by camera, producing IRS-compliant mileage logs and expense reports with zero manual entry.

records.name: GymSocial
records.tagline: Track your workouts. Share the work behind every photo.
records.description: GymSocial connects your workout log to your social feed. Track sets, reps and weights, save routines, and share photos with the full session attached. Follow other lifters and see the training behind their posts. Free workout logging and social features, with Pro insights and unlimited routines. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.

records.name: PeerLoom
records.tagline: Study groups, quizzes and an AI study buddy for students
records.description: PeerLoom is a campus network where students form study groups, chat in real time, take lecturer-set quizzes, and get help from PeerPal, an AI study assistant. Lecturers publish quizzes and track submissions. Built in Ghana for African universities.

records.name: TheGiftHat
records.tagline: Draw Secret Santa names and share wishlists without sign-up
records.description: Add everyone’s names, then send each person a private link to unwrap their Secret Santa match. Guests can share wishlists without creating an account. Meeting in person? Switch to White Elephant to track turns, steals, and the timer on one screen.

records.name: CatLines
records.tagline: Learn English one memorable TV line a day
records.description: Turn memorable TV dialogue into a daily English habit. CatLines pairs one line a day with vocabulary and context, fill-in-the-blank quizzes, dictation, and speaking practice. Explore 2,000 classic Friends lines, revisit what you learn with spaced reviews, and track your progress—one sentence at a time.

records.name: Riff Time
records.tagline: Events, to-dos, routines, diary and mood in one weekly view
records.description: Riff Time puts your whole week on one screen: calendar events, to-dos, daily routines, a diary and your mood, side by side. Sync Google Calendar and iCloud, check off routines with a tap, jot a short diary entry and log how you feel — then look back with the year view and dashboard. Use it on iPhone or in any browser; everything stays in sync. Available in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

records.name: VibeCheckz
records.tagline: Human UX/UI reviews for vibe coders
records.description: Improve your vibe coded website's design, UX, performance, and product clarity with the help of a real senior designer and all the latest AI-powered scans. Delivered to you faster than an agency, cheaper than a freelancer, and with better results than AI scans alone. We'll provide you with a full report of our findings, how your website scored across 10 different categories, and an easy-to-use prompt for your agent to implement all the fixes.

records.name: PDF Nanban
records.tagline: Private PDF tools with Tamil and Hindi OCR
records.description: 21 PDF tools in one place. Edit, sign and fill in PDFs, merge, split, rotate and convert images in your browser, so files never leave your device. Office conversion, compression and OCR in English, Tamil and Hindi run on a server that deletes files right after.

records.name: Outsole
records.tagline: Know when your running shoes are done
records.description: Outsole picks up your runs from Apple Health, suggests which shoe you wore, and warns you at 80% and 100% of each pair's goal. Give shoes roles, import from Strava, see road, gravel and trail. No account.

records.name: Webdesly Club
records.tagline: Membership, events and check-in for private clubs
records.description: Quiet membership desk for private clubs: digital member cards, event RSVPs, and front-desk check-in to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not a generic CRM, not a consumer social app. Free Maison Club Demo, no signup.

records.name: Chakri.ai
records.tagline: Find AI training and expert remote jobs worldwide, free
records.description: Find AI training, data annotation, RLHF and expert remote jobs from platforms worldwide, or post paid tasks and projects and hire global talent. Free to browse, apply with no login.

records.name: Writer Editor
records.tagline: A text editor with AI working on your text with your context
records.description: Writer is a text editor where every AI feature works on your own text, with its context. Select a word for synonyms that fit the sentence, or a sentence for rewrites in the tone and length you want. Plus a copilot that has read your document, and much more.

records.name: Buzzmark
records.tagline: Automated social media in your own voice
records.description: Create a buzz around your brand. Buzzmark is a ghostwriter that writes, plans and schedules your social media in your own voice. Buzz keeps learning that voice from what you publish and every edit you make, and turns the edits you repeat into rules. Every draft is scored 0 to 100 against your voice before you see it. Buzz drafts your week and posts at your audience's best times on 9 platforms. Ask from Claude or ChatGPT over MCP, or use the CLI and API. Agencies get a white-label client portal.

records.name: Vellumove
records.tagline: Turn brand artwork into reels, posters, and product videos
records.description: Turn the artwork you already have into a 3D carousel for social, an animated poster for a campaign, or a product showcase for a launch page. Explore Pro carousel presets and tools in the studio before upgrading. Export video at 720p from three free carousel presets, no account needed. Active Pro membership unlocks exports using Pro presets or features, plus 4K video, GIF, transparent PNG sequences, HTML embeds, and After Effects JSX.

records.name: LovelyYou · 可爱的你·两人书
records.tagline: A shared journal for two, one little memory at a time
records.description: Create a book for two and invite someone special to write with you. LovelyYou helps you save sweet moments, everyday stories, and little “missing you” notes in one shared journal. Sync through iCloud, with no separate account, no ads, and no cross-app tracking.

records.name: Your Indexer
records.tagline: 1-Minute Backlink Indexer for Fast URL Indexing
records.description: Your Indexer helps SEO professionals, marketers and site owners get new URLs and backlinks discovered faster. Submit your links, speed up indexing, and verify that your backlinks have actually been crawled, so you can stop guessing whether your SEO work is being seen. Free to start. The one-time Starter package is just $2 for 110 credits.

records.name: ohluckydraw
records.tagline: Free offline lucky draws, made for your Mac
records.description: Make your event giveaway a shared moment. Import names or IDs and photos, set up prizes, then run separate control and stage windows from one Mac. Reveal up to 30 winners together on standard or ultrawide displays. Each person wins once; results save automatically and export to CSV. Free, offline, for Apple silicon Macs.

records.name: Ardor 2.0
records.tagline: Make friends nearby. Hangouts, circles & walking trails
records.description: Ardor is a local social discovery app to make real-world friends nearby. - Circles & Hangouts: Spontaneous meetups, coffee chats, and group activities. - Map & Trails: Discover walkable routes and local plans around you. - Intent Radar: Pick what you want to do and match with locals nearby. - Icebreakers: Fun mini-games to break the awkwardness before meeting. - Zero Friction: Works directly in your mobile browser with instant alerts.

records.name: Ethoz
records.tagline: The AI-native agentic OS for your company
records.description: The AI-native agentic OS for your company. You built the product in a weekend. Now Ethoz builds the company around it: formation, taxes, compliance and fundraising, one clear next step at a time, each with its official source. Your agents do the heavy lifting from your phone or desktop. You make every call. Nothing is sent, spent or filed without your OK. Your data stays yours, and you can export it anytime. Stop guessing what comes next. Start running a real company.

records.name: InkMagnet
records.tagline: Turn a topic into a typeset ebook in under an hour
records.description: InkMagnet turns a topic into a finished, professionally typeset ebook, not chat text. It researches current sources with citations, writes every chapter, edits the language and exports a print-ready PDF and EPUB with a designed cover. The title, an editable table of contents and a 2-page sample are free; you pay once per book from $5.99, no subscription. Guides, lead magnets, course workbooks, cookbooks, comics and coloring books in 6 languages.

records.name: The Fizzler
records.tagline: Escape defaultthink: oblique ideas for your AI agent
records.description: Agents left alone on open-ended questions fall into defaultthink: they read the usual sources and give the ok answer everyone gets. The good stuff only came when I pointed them off the beaten path first. So I made fizzler.ai to help with that part. Your agent asks it anything and gets ~10 oblique, real things to think from before it answers.

records.name: CareOps AI
records.tagline: AI for healthcare billing, claims, calls and paperwork
records.description: CareOps AI takes repetitive admin work off healthcare practices, so staff spend less time on calls, re-keying and appeal letters, and denied revenue gets recovered faster. Built for US physician practices, billing companies and outpatient clinics: • AI assistant (chat and voice) • Claims and denials • Billing and payment plans • Document intelligence • Human escalation • Compliance and audit • Operations analytics

records.name: Vatsalya Circle
records.tagline: Family elder care: check-ins, missed alerts, SOS, scam help
records.description: A free app for families looking after ageing parents. Medicine and daily check-ins ring like an alarm, the family hears only when one is missed, siblings take turns, SOS alerts everyone, and Safety Check helps elders with scam calls. English, Hindi, Bengali, Kannada.

records.name: RCM Kit
records.tagline: AI agents for healthcare revenue cycle teams
records.description: RCM Kit is the AI foundation SNF billing runs on. It connects to billing systems, payers and banks, keeps each customer’s data isolated, and runs agents that post payments, chase A/R and rebill Medicaid, with staff approving every step. Live and growing.

records.name: MyMarriageBio
records.tagline: Marriage biodata maker: make yours on your phone, free
records.description: MyMarriageBio is a free marriage biodata maker for Indian families. Fill a simple form on your phone and watch your biodata for marriage build live. Mix 3 layouts, 7 colours and 6 borders drawn from Indian motifs like jharokha and jaali, with labels in English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati or Odia. Download a print-ready PDF and share it on WhatsApp. No signup, your draft stays in your browser. Free with a light watermark, or ₹99 for a clean PDF.

records.name: Site to Design Token
records.tagline: any website's design system, ready for your code
records.description: Site to Design Token is a Chrome extension that reads any website's design system: colours by role, type scale, spacing, radius, shadows and contrast. Adjust it live on the page, then export CSS variables, Tailwind, Figma variables, JSON, or a DESIGN.md your AI coding tool can follow. Start from a design you admire instead of shipping another AI-looking app. Scanning, copying and editing are free; downloading the files is a one-time $1.49.

records.name: Scribase Mail
records.tagline: Resend-compatible email API, switch with one line
records.description: Scribase Mail is a transactional email API compatible with Resend. Keep the official resend SDK, point it at mail-api.scribase.com (or set RESEND_BASE_URL) and existing sends keep working. Your own domain with DKIM, SPF and DMARC checks, signed webhooks, open and click tracking, one-click unsubscribe, sk_test_ keys that never deliver, and teams with roles. Free: 3,000 emails a month. Pro: $20 a month for 50,000, then $0.80 per 1,000. Scale: $90 for 150,000.

records.name: SpeedReading.com Academy
records.tagline: Clear your reading backlog. Keep what matters.
records.description: Make your reading an advantage in your studies and career. SpeedReading.com helps you build the speed and understanding to take in the knowledge behind better exam preparation, stronger job applications and professional growth. Get through demanding reading with a purpose, and leave more time for the rest of your life. Try the free demos; full access is available by subscription.

records.name: Antiqly: Antique Identifier
records.tagline: Antique identifier app: snap a photo, see what it's worth
records.description: Antiqly is an antique identifier app for iPhone and Android. Identify antiques by photo: snap a vase, a silver tray or a pocket watch and see what it is, when and where it was made, and its story. It reads maker's marks and hallmarks with a confidence level, and shows a value range from similar listings online, with the number of listings behind it. Tap the closest match and the range updates. 11,000+ App Store downloads, 4.3 stars from 174 ratings.

records.name: SocialGTM
records.tagline: The Swiss Army knife for go-to-market on social
records.description: SocialGTM runs your go-to-market on social. It builds a 30-day growth roadmap for Reddit and X, writes your posts and lets you schedule them, and finds people asking for a tool like yours on X, Reddit, HN, Bluesky, and LinkedIn, with replies in your voice. It also tracks brand and competitor mentions, SEO threads, and every lead, and has an MCP server. You approve everything and press Post yourself on X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and HN. Plans start at $9 a month.

records.name: HEICase
records.tagline: HEIC to JPG and PNG on iPhone and Mac
records.description: HEICase converts HEIC photos to JPG, PNG and more on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Crop, rotate, resize and adjust quality before export. Photos are processed locally. Single-photo conversion is free; a one-time Pro purchase unlocks batch conversion, including on Mac, and text watermarks.

records.name: Guitar Lab
records.tagline: Practice guitar with interactive tabs and backing tracks
records.description: Guitar Lab helps you practice tricky guitar passages at your own pace on Mac and Windows. I built it so you can start with a guided exercise or import a Guitar Pro score, then use interactive tabs to loop a passage at a slower tempo. You can also play along with backing tracks and track your progress locally.

records.name: Bergamot Essential Oil
records.tagline: Bergamot essential oil, cold-pressed with nothing added
records.description: Rootsar Bergamot Essential Oil is cold-pressed from bergamot peel, with a bright citrus scent and a soft floral note. Nothing added. Diffuse it, blend it into your body oil, or add it to a homemade spray. A small amount lasts for months.

records.name: Link Elf
records.tagline: Save webpages to boards, then find them by search
records.description: Save webpages into custom boards and categories, then search saved links by title, website, board or category. Save from the browser extension and return to your links in Link Elf. Free to use with an optional Pro plan for higher workspace limits.

records.name: ruly
records.tagline: Stock checklist and investment journal
records.description: Your stock checklist and investment journal: your criteria, figures from annual reports, a verdict for each criterion and a dated record of every decision.

records.name: ClusterBite
records.tagline: Cut your Databricks bill. Pay only from what you save.
records.description: A Databricks cost dashboard and a ranked list of cost fixes, from read-only access to your system tables. Use it hosted, or we install it as a Docker app inside your network.

records.name: Toma Buena
records.tagline: Cut flubbed takes from talking-head videos automatically
records.description: Toma Buena finds the failed takes (you start a sentence, stumble and say it again) and the long silences in talking-head recordings, and builds a first cut with the good take. It keeps repetitions you make on purpose and explains every cut. Review in the browser, then export MP4, Premiere Pro XML or Final Cut Pro FCPXML. Handles 60-min, 8 GB files. Spanish, Catalan and English recordings (interface in Spanish). Free beta.

records.name: CleanPDF Rearrange PDF
records.tagline: Drag to reorder, delete or add PDF pages. No upload.
records.description: See every page as a thumbnail, drag pages into the order you want, delete the ones you don't need and insert blank pages anywhere. Save and download the new PDF at its original quality. Everything runs in your browser, so your file is never uploaded. Free, with no sign-up and no watermark.

records.name: Marginalia
records.tagline: Book Search Engine - Matches with the right books
records.description: A distraction-free literary companion that recommends five books tailored to what you are experiencing right now.

records.name: TextRemover.video
records.tagline: Remove hardcoded subtitles & text from video with AI
records.description: Upload a video and AI erases burned-in subtitles, captions, titles or any area you box, then rebuilds the background instead of blurring it. Original resolution, no watermark. MP4/MOV up to 60s. 30 free seconds on signup, no card.

records.name: ChargeKr
records.tagline: Turn private EV chargers into a shared charging network
records.description: ChargeKr connects EV drivers with available private chargers nearby. Drivers can discover charging spots, plan trips and request bookings. Charger owners can list their chargers, set pricing and availability, and earn from unused charging capacity. Built to make EV charging more accessible across India.

records.name: Blankleaf
records.tagline: Free Online Notepad with Tabs, Markdown & Autosave
records.description: Open the page and start typing. Tabs, Markdown with a / menu and shortcuts, code highlighting, version history and encrypted share links. No sign-up, no server: notes stay in your browser and work offline. Free and open source.

records.name: awaig
records.tagline: The most creative place on the Internet
records.description: awaig is a social network dedicated to AI-generated content. Discover entertaining, imaginative images, share your own creations, and connect with a new generation of creators. We're building a feed worth scrolling for, without the usual AI slop.

records.name: FindKOL.Pro
records.tagline: From creator search to first outreach email — in minutes
records.description: FindKOL.Pro is a influencer(KOL) workspace for business teams. Search creators on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Xiaohongshu (RED), Douyin and X; spot inflated views with fake-follower signals; describe your campaign in one brief and let AI recommend scored creators with evidence. Unlock verified emails (no hit, no charge), approve AI-drafted outreach from Gmail or Outlook, and trace every sale with Shopify discount-code attribution. Free plan: daily searches, lists, CRM and outreach inbox.

records.name: PingWise
records.tagline: Uptime alerts only when three continents agree it's down
records.description: PingWise is uptime monitoring that doesn't cry wolf. When one probe sees a failure, all 20 probes on six continents check your site every 5 seconds: DNS, connection, TLS, HTTP. You're paged only when two thirds agree, across three continents and three networks, and the alert says what broke. Prepaid credits instead of seats or tiers: every account gets every alert channel, status pages, the API and the whole team. Free credits every month, no card needed.

records.name: Ghost Downloader
records.tagline: Downloader that sniffs page media and records live streams.
records.description: A fast, modern downloader that sniffs page media and records live streams. HTTP, BitTorrent, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH and eD2k live in one app, each protocol on the engine built for it, so it replaces five tools. Free and open source.

records.name: BizPulse - Your Business Pulse
records.tagline: Offline cashflow tracking for solopreneurs and freelancers
records.description: Track cashflow offline and build financial literacy. Built for solopreneurs, founders, co-founders and freelancers. Core app free; optional Pro adds weekly AI insights.

records.name: BookmarkLane
records.tagline: A native bookmark manager for Mac, iPhone and iPad
records.description: Save and organize bookmarks on Mac, iPhone and iPad with folders, tags and smart lists. Start free, with optional private iCloud sync on Pro.

records.name: ToolDeck
records.tagline: Tech and tool deals with prices checked every few hours
records.description: ToolDeck collects 1,000+ live promo codes and Amazon deals on tech, software and tools. Every Amazon price is re-checked every few hours, expired offers are removed automatically, and each code shows where it works. No sign-up needed.

records.name: catude
records.tagline: See why your Claude Code usage runs out
records.description: A terminal app and CLI that shows where your Claude Code tokens went, trims what loads into every session per project, maps which subagents run and what they cost, and audits what you installed for secrets and risky commands. One binary, no account, no telemetry. Windows, macOS, Linux and WSL.

records.name: ClassToybox
records.tagline: Classroom timers, name pickers and games for teachers
records.description: ClassToybox brings classroom timers, random name pickers, a spinning wheel and games into your browser. Six tools are free with no sign-up, including a timer, two name pickers, Spin the Wheel, Tug of War and Christmas Lucky Draw. Optional membership adds team quizzes, vocabulary activities, scoreboards and more.

records.name: MascotPing
records.tagline: Animated mascots for WordPress and WooCommerce
records.description: MascotPing brings announcements, social proof and offers to life with animated mascots. Start free with Ping, one active campaign and a WooCommerce coupon bar. Premium unlocks all 10 mascots, multiple campaigns, cart reminders, animated sale badges and advanced analytics. Preview campaigns on desktop and mobile, control when they appear, and localize messages with Falang across 13 languages.

records.name: Zoomies
records.tagline: Dog activity tracker and care reminder
records.description: Zoomies gives your dog a daily exercise goal based on breed, age and energy. Log walks, play, fetch, hikes and swims in a couple of taps and watch the meter fill. Family members join the same dog by QR code, so everyone sees who walked the dog today. A shared Care list covers meals, flea treatment and vet checks, with a reminder until someone ticks it off. No GPS and no collar needed. Free to start, on iPhone.

records.name: MahjCan
records.tagline: American Mah Jongg online, built for my mom
records.description: MahjCan is American Mah Jongg and Canasta online, made for the people who actually play it. Big tiles, the full Charleston, no clock, and a table for your weekly group with reminders and season standings. Plays this year's League hands with your own printed card. Free daily puzzle and an at-the-table scorekeeper. 30 days free.

records.name: GoodReadence
records.tagline: Private Online EPUB & PDF Flipbook Reader
records.description: Turn PDFs and EPUBs into a private reading room. Enjoy book-style page turns, notes, highlights and ambient sound. Explore 750 complete classics or bring your own books. Your books and progress stay in your browser by default, with ZIP backups and direct device transfers when you need them. Free to use, with no account required. Good riddance to bad reads.

records.name: Autario
records.tagline: Car costs, MOT & insurance reminders in one offline app
records.description: Autario keeps every car's MOT, tax and insurance renewals, fuel and running costs, and full service history in one place. Scan your documents instead of typing, share cars with family, and export a PDF history when you sell. Works offline, no account needed, no ads. Available in Polish, English, Ukrainian, German and Spanish. Free to start; Pro unlocks unlimited cars, charts and reports.

records.name: Lykeion
records.tagline: A research lab where AI agents and researchers work together
records.description: Lykeion is an open-source research lab where AI agents carry out scientific work and people steer it. Each question becomes a study that moves through Grounding, Hypotheses, Experimentation and Validation, advancing only when its gate passes. Every claim an agent keeps cites a recorded source from OpenAlex, Europe PMC or arXiv, and review of each study is powered by Jev. Agents run on your own machine, inside a sandbox.

records.name: PlatypusOS
records.tagline: You haven't seen what your team can really do.
records.description: What if your sales team spent less time prospecting and more time closing? Your marketing team less time posting and more time discovering new markets? Your support team less time answering routine questions and more time building relationships? PlatypusOS gives every employee a personalized AI teammate that learns how they work, connects to their existing apps, and handles the busywork. Less busywork. More brilliance. Unlimited potential.

records.name: Ungated
records.tagline: Job search tracker. Pay once, never a subscription.
records.description: Track applications and follow-ups, share with a coach if you want. Free for your first 30 jobs, then a one-time pass. Never a subscription.

records.name: ApplyReef
records.tagline: We apply to jobs for you. You just show up to interviews.
records.description: ApplyReef applies to jobs in your field for you. We polish your résumé (you approve it, nothing invented), set up a dedicated job-search inbox in your name, apply across Ashby, Greenhouse and Workday, and forward every interview request to you.

records.name: Smart Tank Club
records.tagline: Free tools to plan, stock and test your aquarium
records.description: Smart Tank Club helps fishkeepers run healthier tanks. Plan a new tank, check if your fish and plants get along with the stocking calculator, and log water tests to get advice that fits your readings. Browse a catalog of fish, plants and gear. The tools are free for your first tank; a paid plan adds up to 10 tanks.

records.name: Shhots AI for iOS
records.tagline: Turn one product photo into photos and video ads on iPhone
records.description: Turn a product photo on your iPhone into studio photos, creator-style UGC, cinematic videos and podcast ads. For online sellers and brand marketers creating campaign assets without organizing a shoot. Choose from 47 photo styles, make UGC in 12 languages, or generate 10–30 second product videos. Pick your photo, choose a look, and create in the app. Try it today!

records.name: Best Electrician Jobs
records.tagline: Hire electricians from Claude or ChatGPT
records.description: A job board for electricians and low-voltage techs, run by one person for two years. 6,000+ open jobs and 35,000+ journeyman résumés. Employers can now connect Claude or ChatGPT to check applicants, read résumés, draft jobs and pause postings.

records.name: Kleido
records.tagline: Website to printed business & stamp cards — on web or MCP
records.description: Your website already has your logo and colors. Paste your URL and Kleido designs two-sided business cards or loyalty stamp cards (with head-start stamps) in your real brand—no template editor. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or Cursor via MCP (kleidoprint.com/mcp) to design, edit live, and order from chat. My dad's LA print shop prints and ships them—growing into a full agentic print shop (books, scrapbooks and more next). First design free; 100 cards are $34.99, US shipping included.

records.name: ASO Studio Connect
records.tagline: Track App Review, analytics and ASO keywords on iPhone
records.description: Know the moment App Review moves: a push and a Live Activity for every status change, against today’s median review times. Plus clean charts for downloads, conversion and proceeds, and your ASO keyword ranks tracked daily. All on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Vitrine
records.tagline: App Store screenshots, designed in minutes
records.description: A web editor that turns app screenshots into App Store and Google Play screenshot sets for every device size, in 37 languages, exported as one ZIP with no watermark.
